newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus sees Q4 EPS "in the teens".
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus sees Q4 EPS "in the teens".

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc Chief Financial Officer Glen Shaeffer on Wednesday said the company expected to report fourth-quarter earnings per share "in the teens" and first-quarter EPS of less than $0.50.
"The number will be in the teens," Shaeffer told reporters at the Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference in New York, referring to the company's fourth-quarter earnings per share.
Analysts on average had estimated the company's fourth-quarter earnings at $0.26 per share, according to a First Call survey. The First Call consensus for the first quarter is $0.49 per share.
Shaeffer said the fourth quarter was a "construction quarter," while the first-quarter results would reflect the tail end of that activity, particularly work at the company's Luxor property.
The first-quarter results also exclude revenues from the Hacienda Hotel Casino, which was demolished to make way for a new resort.
Shaeffer said the company had repurchased more than 10 million shares. He said the buyback would be accretive in the current fiscal year.
He said the company was expecting about $1.8 billion in capital spending during the next three to five years, including expenditures on new projects in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
